references.text: God's sons saw that the daughters of men were beautiful and took them as wives – a similar theme about seeing beauty and taking a wife
Abram saw that Sarai was a beautiful woman – the same expression for seeing beauty in a woman
Rachel was beautiful in form and appearance, and Jacob loved her – a similar description of female beauty and love
Shechem saw Dinah and desired her – similar language about seeing a woman and being attracted to her
Instructions concerning women taken as captives in war – related context about prisoners of war
Benjamin's sons took wives from the women at Shiloh – a similar practice of taking women as wives
David saw Bathsheba and took her – the same pattern of seeing a beautiful woman and desiring her
Esther was beautiful in form and appearance – the same Hebrew expression for beauty (יְפַת־תֹּאַר)
